title: Degree of an Array
description: Find the smallest subarray length that has the same degree as the original array.
pseudocode:
1. map = {}, left = {}, right = {}
2. for i, x in nums:
3.   if x not in left: left[x] = i
4.   right[x] = i
5.   map[x] = map.get(x, 0) + 1
6. degree = max(map.values())
7. minLen = len(nums)
8. for x in map:
9.   if map[x] == degree:
10.    minLen = min(minLen, right[x] - left[x] + 1)

steps.note: Initializing maps and iterating through array
Record first occurrence of 1 at index 0
Record first occurrence of 2 at index 1
Update right occurrence of 2 at index 2
Calculate length for candidate 2: indices 1 to 2, length 2
Calculate length for candidate 1: indices 0 to 4, length 5
